targets.name: Shackleton Crater Rim (Lunar South Pole)
targets.mission_focus: Permanent Lunar Base (Artemis Program) - Illumination & Water Ice
engineering_applications: Vertical solar array testing under low-angle polar grazing illumination (LRO LROC/LOLA).
Cryogenic drilling and water-ice extraction (ISRU) validation in cold regolith (LRO Diviner/LEND).
Autonomous rover navigation across high-contrast shadow boundaries and rough terrain (LRO Mini-RF).
analogy_breakdowns: Lunar gravity (1.62 m/s² vs. 9.81 m/s² on Earth): alters wheel traction and excavation mechanics.
Ultra-high vacuum (10⁻¹² torr) and complete absence of atmosphere or wind erosion.
Direct exposure to galactic cosmic rays and solar wind without a global magnetosphere.

targets.name: Jezero Crater (Mars)
official_nasa_sources: NASA Planetary Data System - MRO CRISM, HiRISE & MOLA (pds.nasa.gov)
NASA Mars Odyssey THEMIS Thermal Infrared (pds.nasa.gov)
engineering_applications: Calibration of spectrometers and biosignature sensors in hyper-arid sulfate and clay soils.
Hermetic dust-seal testing against fine iron-oxide and perchlorate-bearing particulates.
Rover traverse simulations across ancient lacustrine deltaic fans.
analogy_breakdowns: Martian gravity (3.72 m/s², ~38% of Earth's gravity).
Thin CO₂ atmosphere (~6.1 hPa vs. 1013 hPa on Earth): parachutes and rotors require vacuum chambers.
Mean global temperature of -63 °C cannot be sustained continuously in warm terrestrial deserts.

targets.name: Arcadia Planitia (Mars)
targets.mission_focus: Future Human Landing Site & Subsurface Ice Mining
official_nasa_sources: NASA Planetary Data System - MRO SHARAD Subsurface Radar & MOLA (pds.nasa.gov)
engineering_applications: Ground-penetrating radar (GPR / SAR) validation for mapping shallow subsurface water-ice sheets.
Vertical descent lander and habitat deployment testing on ultra-low-slope plains.
Automated subsurface ice-melting and water purification system operations.
analogy_breakdowns: Atmospheric pressure near the triple point of water causes direct ice sublimation upon exposure.
Global dust storms with electrostatic charging profiles distinct from terrestrial storms.
Reduced gravity and elevated surface UV-C radiation flux.
